title: Publish GPU-centric AI for Science configuration planner Candidate v0.2
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's September 7, 2026 explicit implementation request for Candidate v0.2 and a Pull Request that can publish it on OpenFS Pages after authorized merge. The approved public surface consists of a public-evidence mode and a browser-local What-if mode, the separated system policy, reference architecture ARCH-GPU-CENTRIC-AI4S-001, generated CFGRESULT artifacts, a GPU product catalog, a date- and jurisdiction-specific procurement assessment, and a user-input template. It must remain visibly provisional, single-model and single-agent, Consensus-incomplete, and prohibited for procurement use. Public-evidence mode must not infer unsupported prices, delivery conditions, facility constraints, workload demand, or performance. What-if values must be visibly identified as user assumptions, remain in the browser unless explicitly downloaded, and must not be sent to GA4 or another external service. This authorizes preparation of a Pull Request and publication only after an authorized merge and successful Pages deployment; it does not authorize merging, asserting scientific Consensus, recommending a vendor, publishing non-public information, or treating estimates as vendor quotations.
